findings.real: FIA 2026 Hungarian GP map "CIRCUIT CENTRELINE LENGTH - 4.381km"; OSM relation 284557 4371 m. Where game and OSM differ by > 3 m the 2026 cars' median path is closer to the game line (mean |car - game| 2.6 m vs |car - OSM| 5.3 m): the OSM ways are the less accurate ones

findings.game: start / finish line (dataset point 0) 373 m before Turn 1 apex, under the footbridge (OSM way 493519980)
findings.real: the real start / control line is ~240 m earlier: 2025 Hungarian GP grid pole car (16) at -244.5 m, P2 (81) -249.5 m, P3 (4) -260.6 m; 2026 grid pole at -243.5 m; FIA 2026 circuit map: START LINE and CONTROL LINE side by side ~600 m before T1 (scaled with its "SPEED TRAP [T] - 310m before T1"); no OSM start / finish node
findings.proposedFix: START_AT 'hu-1986': [47.5789212, 19.2483897] (game centreline 240 m before the current line; +-10 m). Moves the grid, the timing line and the generic pit lane; the scenery pit building (s -280..+32 around the old line) then lies around the line as it should

findings.real: F1 car heights (2026 qualifying): range 34.7 m, 6.1% / -7.3% over 50 m, s 2400-3700 +5.4 m; formula1.com 34.7 m; de.wikipedia "Höhenunterschied ... 36 m, der größte Anstieg beträgt 6,2 % und das größte Gefälle 7,0 %"; EU-DEM 39.7 m / SRTM 36.5 m (surface models). Game vs car heights: rms 2.11 m, max 4.6 m at s 1175, grade over 100 m rms 1.48 pp, max 3.4 pp
